prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your existing account to instantly restore your previously adopted pets and saved progress."}}
1: [adoption, redesign] pick_friend_style_preview_redesign: Redesigns pet selection with interactive preview components and detailed trait badges.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "two_column", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_animated_preview", "style": "emphasis"}, {"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Choose Your Companion", "action": "choose", "style": "playful"}]}}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] upload_photos_new_custom_pet_flow: Introduces a visual upload flow with real-time photo quality feedback and interactive pet asset preview.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"components": [{"type": "photo_picker", "label": "Select Clear Front-Facing Photo", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "badge", "text": "Photo Quality Check: Good Lighting Detected", "style": "highlight"}]}}

   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "You will receive a notification as soon as your desktop pet is ready to appear on your screen."}}

   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Right-click your pet anytime to access quick controls, adjust visibility, or hide companion."}}
5: [finish, new_screen] new_desktop_controls_overview_screen: Adds a final desktop controls overview screen to onboarding that demonstrates pet interaction shortcuts.
   config: {"new_controls_overview": {"headline": "Master Your Desktop Companion Controls", "body": "Drag to move your pet, right-click for controls, and double-click to play.", "button_label": "Start Exploring", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Right-click for Menu • Drag to Move • Click to Interact", "style": "emphasis"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_controls_overview"]}
6: [adoption, redesign] adoption_certificate_badge_seal_redesign: Replaces the default certificate stamp with an official adoption mascot seal and animated celebratory badge.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"replace": {"official_stamp": [{"role": "official_stamp", "type": "badge", "text": "Official Adoption Seal", "style": "highlight"}, {"role": "official_stamp", "type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:mascot_seal", "style": "playful"}]}}}
7: [choose_path, hint] choose_path_reassurance_badge_hint: Adds a clear path description hint clarifying instant vs custom adoption options.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Pick instant adopt for ready-made companions or create custom pet from your own photos."}}
8: [choose_path, copy] story_mascot_welcome_copy: Updates story screen copy with clear focus on bringing an animated pet companion to life on desktop.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "body": "Bring an interactive pet right onto your desktop screen in just a few quick setup steps.", "button_label": "Begin Setup"}}
9: [home, wait_info] waiting_desktop_launch_wait_info: Displays progress indicator and time estimate while pet desktop assets are being prepared.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Preparing desktop graphics and rendering animations. Your companion will appear shortly."}}
